title: Breakaway civilization behind the men at the door

tellings.quote: I think there is a breakaway civilization and we're talking about it right now.

plain: Whitley Strieber, an author known for writing about his own encounters with what he calls visitors, believes a "breakaway civilization" exists: a hidden group that has split off from ordinary society and works on its own. He links this to the strange men who have turned up at his door, and uses a term associated with the UFO historian Richard Dolan. If true, it would mean some of what people blame on aliens is really the work of a secret human group.
